literal_meaning: মিন মিন করে এমন শব্দ বা আচরণ
figurative_meaning_en: whining or complaining in a low, persistent, petty manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই মিনমিনে কাজ নিয়ে সময় নষ্ট করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He always whines about petty things.
Don't waste time on such trivial nitpicking.
note: Onomatopoeic expression mimicking a low whining sound, common in colloquial Bengali.
